name: AO SMITH X2
summary: A.O. Smith X2 (UV + UF) Water Purifier is a sleek and compact purifier designed for municipal water supply (TDS below 200 ppm) . Powered by a 5-stage UV + UF purification system , it provides clean, safe, and healthy drinking water with double protection.
intro: The A.O. Smith X2 (UV + UF) Water Purifier is designed for municipal corporation water with TDS below 200 ppm. Featuring a 5-stage UV + UF purification system, it delivers clean, healthy, and safe drinking water while preserving essential minerals. Its sleek, compact design allows for both wall-mounted and tabletop installation, making it a perfect fit for modern kitchens. With a 5-litre food-grade storage tank, digital display, and high water flow, the X2 combines convenience with reliable performance.
